comment: WarpLink's half of its component descriptor: everything that cannot be
read out of the tree. No version appears here -- 'requires[].versionFrom'
says where the consumed cmd-tlm version lives and the emitter reads it,
because a version typed by a person is a claim about the code rather than

why: Not optional: without a cmd_tlm.json there is no command and telemetry
dictionary, and WarpLink has nothing to present. The version is read
from the constant the loader checks against, so the descriptor cannot
claim to read a schema this tool would refuse.
Ports transcribed from this repo's compose.yaml rather than chosen. Every
one is loopback-bound here: 2900 and 2943 (Traefik GUI), 5005/udp
That is a change worth recording. In the previous deployment repo the FSW
telemetry and command ports were '5005:5005/udp' and '5006:5006/udp' with
no host prefix -- every interface -- while the authenticated GUI was
loopback only. The unauthenticated UDP path was the exposed one. This repo
binds all of them to 127.0.0.1, and 5006 is no longer published at all.
Declaring them means the hub prints the scopes rather than leaving them in
the presence or absence of a '127.0.0.1:' prefix in YAML, which is where

cmdtlm.generate.why: Turns a cmd_tlm.json into the COSMOS target definition WarpLink serves.
